t: Nothing of it survives, but this is where King's Cross began. It was a short-lived building, put up in 1830 as the base of a memorial to the recently dead King George the Fourth. A statue of him was added in 1835, removed in 1842, and the whole structure was demolished in 1845. George had been prince regent from 1811, during his father's final illness, and became king in 1820. The area still carries the name of this vanished monument.
